106754.title: Angel Guts: Red Classroom
106754.overview: When Muraki, a porn magazine editor, watches a blue film depicting a gang rape in a school, he becomes obsessed with the lead actress. Quite by chance, whilst looking to reserve a location for a shoot, he happens to encounter her at a love hotel where she works as a receptionist. Her name is Nami and she reluctantly agrees to speak with him, and confesses that it was her in the film. Then, Muraki tells Nami that he wants her to model for him.
106754.trailerName: Angel Guts: Red Classroom 天使のはらわた 赤い教室 (Directed by Chusei Sone) Trailer

910850.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
910850.overview: Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway Noa is drawn to a mysterious girl named Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for Mafty's mission -- the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Meanwhile, Kenneth Sleg of the Earth Federation Forces prepares a defense operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate Mafty and is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfill her own role.

1021634.title: Max, Min and Meowzaki
1021634.overview: Max and Min are about to break up. They argue endlessly about dividing their possessions, including their cat, Meowzaki, whom they have named after their favorite artist Miyazaki Hayao. Max’s father Ramesh, who lost his wife and has since been suffering from insomnia, meets charming therapist Dhaara. Max’s grandfather Sridhar, secretly enjoys drinking with his new friend Jennifer at the nursing home.

1159810.title: The World Before
1159810.overview: On a small island, Jin, a teenage girl going through puberty, begins her first love affair with her best friend Dujae.

1176962.title: Rose
1176962.overview: In the turmoil of the Thirty-Years' War, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village claiming to be heir to a long-abandoned manor. His quest for recognition and acceptance are complicated by his secret: under a false identity, false name, and pretense of a false gender, he has made his way to the village. But to achieve her goals, Rose, as the soldier is actually called, will stop at nothing.
1176962.trailerName: Rose | Trailer | Markus Schleinzer | Sandra Hüller

1254594.title: Omukade
1254594.overview: Thailand, 1941 — a handful of Japanese soldiers and their prisoners are trapped in a cursed mine. As tensions between enemies reach a breaking point, they are forced to confront a terrifying, ancient monster lurking in the shadows.

1268930.title: Little Brownie Kuzya 2
1268930.overview: Kuzya continues to live with Natasha and her family. Baba Yaga has finally moved into the human world and is trying to be useful, becoming an unexpected helper for others. Everything seems calm, but a mysterious Quiet Woman comes to their house, which begins a new wave of magical and dangerous events. Everyone will have to unite again to protect the world from Koshchei and keep the world of fairy tales as magical and bright.

1292610.title: Sajen Satu Suro
1292610.overview: Tania (Aisyah Aqilah) returns to Maduabang Village with Jeff (Cinta Brian Glenn Roberts), Laura (Frislly Herlinda Balqis), and Robby (Munggaran Meldrat). They plan to return the heirloom keris belonging to her grandfather, Sapto Dilogo (Clift Sangra), in order to cure her mother, who is suffering from a mysterious illness. Their arrival with the keris stirs up the villagers’ fears that the spirit of Sumarni (Assila Corina ) has returned. The bride-to-be was murdered by Sapto Dilogo with that very keris. Tania and her friends find themselves caught up in the revenge plot of Suparti (Yurike Prastica) and Aryoseno (Harris Syaus), which is closely tied to a past tragedy that occurred on the night of 1 Suro. Amid supernatural terror and a series of attacks that claim victims, Tania finally uncovers the dark truth about her family.

1300738.title: Iyus Jenius
1300738.overview: Following the tragic loss of his father, a demoralized ten-year-old boy overcomes severe emotional distress and academic decline through the guidance of an whimsical imaginary friend, who helps him reclaim his confidence and intellectual potential.

1301442.title: The Portal
1301442.overview: An assistant of a CEO goes on a dangerous journey to save the multiverse after his company fails to showcase a prototype of their revolutionary invention - the Portal.

1321666.title: The Doll
1321666.overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

1322562.title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
1322562.overview: Peace returns to Edo Castle's Ooku, but ominous signs persist. The Medicine Seller uncovers the origins of a deadly conspiracy rooted in a 150-year-old secret involving the Ooku's creation, ancient grudges, and hidden truths. He faces the powerful serpent god, embodying the Ooku's dark history, risking everything to stop it.

1336770.title: Vaazha II
1336770.overview: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. They face immense social pressure as they reach adulthood, embarking them on an emotional journey of self discovery and acceptance, where they finally learn to take up their responsibilities and find success.

1358274.title: Starlight
1358274.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

1365378.title: The American Dream
1365378.overview: No one would have bet on Jérémy, stuck behind the counter of a video store, or on Bouna, who cleans airports. With no money, no connections, and painfully poor English, who could have predicted they’d one day become big-name agents in the NBA? What they lack in experience, they will make up for in audacity, while remaining true to their one credo, doing business with a human touch. Scouting raw talent while improvising their way up, they’ll fake it until they make it – chasing their American Dream and landing multi-million-dollar deals.

1369410.title: ROLLING
1369410.overview: A young couple confront their landlord over rent, only to find themselves in over their heads when unexpected events spiral out of control.

1376450.title: Pieces of a Foreign Life
1376450.overview: Woman flees war-torn Syria, leaving family behind. Seeking asylum in Bordeaux, she meets French lawyer who helps her rebuild life. Unexpected relationship forms between them amid her struggle to resettle.

1384514.title: The Vvaan
1384514.overview: A rational urban man defies his ancestral forbidden forest & awakens a divine goddess, only to realise that some powers exist beyond logic & he must rise as the village’s only saviour to protect his people from annihilation.

1387778.title: Next Life
1387778.overview: Ivy finds herself confronted with parallel universes in which her life unspools in very different ways set against the modern London jazz scene.

1396674.title: Dog Day Evening
1396674.overview: A hostage situation occurred at a TV station. The kidnapper K was not after money, he just wanted to terminate the monthly subscription to the TV station.
1396674.trailerName: 電影《一個部門的誕生》預告片

1428226.title: Hasta el fin del mundo
1428226.overview: Manuel's life is upended when Esmeralda, his lost love from 15 years ago, calls unexpectedly. Despite being set to marry another, he rediscovers Esmeralda, and they realize their love transcends time.

1432706.title: Bury the Devil
1432706.overview: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

1436738.title: Down the Arm of God
1436738.overview: A young pastor goes through a harsh winter in a small Texas town, where his mission to help the homeless is faced with resistance by his congregation, exposing deep-seated prejudice and systemic failures.

1437698.title: Horst Schlämmer sucht das Glück
1437698.overview: Horst Schlämmer is back—and he's fed up. People all over Germany are in a bad mood. So he leaves Grevenbroich and sets off in search of happiness. It must be somewhere!

1447810.title: The Last Dinosaur
1447810.overview: Rex the dinosaur, whose father is the king of dinosaurs is snatched and transported to the 21st century in a time machine, and must team up with a motely crew in an attempt to find his way home, 65 million years back in time.

1462146.title: S4: The Bob Lazar Story
1462146.overview: Over 35 years after Bob Lazar's revelations, this documentary exposes secrets of a facility the government still denies. Featuring Lazar's testimony, recreations, and new evidence, it reopens a case that continues to spark global curiosity
1462146.trailerName: S4: The Bob Lazar Story | Official 4K Trailer 2025 NEW

1464258.title: The Invisible Half
1464258.overview: Elena, a "half" Japanese high school girl, struggles with her identity. While constantly watched, she discovers she's also being watched by something else—a monster that can only be seen through her smartphone and heard through her earphones.

1471810.title: Mommy Down to the Ride
1471810.overview: A strict physics teacher tries to talk her teenage son out of dropping out of school and becoming a professional skateboarder. She makes a bet with him that if she competes in a major skateboarding competition, he will stay in school. Under the tutorship of one of her poorest pupils, she learns to skate, unaware that she's putting her career and reputation at stake.

1476994.title: Unboxing
1476994.overview: Popular blogger Vlad tries to attract attention to his concert in an original way - he puts himself up for auction. The lot immediately goes to the son of a rich businessman. Now Vlad is obliged to entertain Borya for a whole week. All attempts to break the contract run into huge fines, and then Vlad decides to really piss off Borya and make a video blog out of his life. In response, Borya arranges more and more new challenges for him.

1495490.title: Infinite Icon: A Visual Memoir
1495490.overview: Paris Hilton's musical journey unfolds through rare footage and intimate moments, from her debut album to her latest work. A raw look at her evolution as an artist and icon, blending performances with personal revelations.
1495490.trailerName: Infinite Icon: A Visual Memoir Official Extended Trailer | Tickets On Sale | Paris Hilton

1496450.title: Pirunduk
1496450.overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime

1511426.title: BAHUBURA
1511426.overview: Mr. Teacher, a quiet and principled schoolteacher, is devastated after losing his only child in a tragic road accident. The very same day, at the accident site, he comes across another injured boy-abandoned, nameless, and unconscious. Everyone around looks the other way, but Mr. Teacher steps in to help. As he nurses the boy back to health, he discovers the child is a victim of a deeper evil-caught in the clutches of a trafficking network. What begins as an act of kindness becomes a mission of justice.

1513026.title: A Scary Movie
1513026.overview: During the summer holidays, a documentary-maker and his 12 year-old son stay at an abandoned hotel in Lisbon: an empty hotel like the one in the film The Shining.

1513730.title: Guantanamera
1513730.overview: The adventure action film centers on a famous extreme sports blogger who, having arrived in Cuba, finds herself involved in the mysterious story of a document that disappeared many years ago, according to which America was supposed to return the Guantanamo base to Cuba. Both the special services and a serious businessman have been hunting for it for a long time. However, only her grandfather, former intelligence officer Leo Voronov, a retired KGB general, with whom she does not communicate, knows where this document is. In parallel with the action in our time, the film will also tell about the adventures of Voronov shortly before the Cuban Revolution in 1958.

1515714.title: The Street Photographer
1515714.overview: Matthijs is a street photographer in Amsterdam, aiming to succeed and grow within his profession. A new client gives him a unique photography assignment: create a photo that captures the spirit of art in Amsterdam.  Matthijs travels the city in search of the best photo, ultimately learning not only what he considers the essence of true art, but also how he can become a better artist himself.

1522690.title: The Lost Children of Tuam
1522690.overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.
1522690.trailerName: Official Trailer: The Lost Children of Tuam in Cinemas September 25th

1532610.title: INK
1532610.overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

1534530.title: The Whisper
1534530.overview: Fleeing from their violent father, siblings Lucía and Adrián take refuge in a remote mansion. With the help of a hidden micro-camera on a cat, Lucía uncovers a terrifying secret: their neighbors are part of a criminal network that kidnaps teenage girls to make snuff films, and they intend to get rid of the siblings. As Lucía fights to protect her brother, she must face a dark family curse that follows them into their newfound sanctuary.

1540354.title: Jonah Was Here
1540354.overview: When Bob finds himself in the student room of his deceased son Jonah, the fifty-something finds himself unable to leave. He dives into his son's unfinished student life where unexpected encounters and discoveries await.

1542274.title: Straight Shot
1542274.overview: A bodyguard past his prime fights through a skyscraper full of mercenaries to save his ex-fiancée trapped in an experimental coffin.

1548546.title: Blue Skies on Mars
1548546.overview: Loss, betrayal and revenge are what fuel ex mafia enforcer Matthew Quinn. Approaching the end of a 20 year sentence on a Martian penal colony he finds himself at a crossroads. Returning to Earth to settle the score means losing the love of his life… a second time.

1550338.title: The Last Scene
1550338.overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

1563970.title: Caity
1563970.overview: Along with her newly sober father Paul, 16-year-old Caity prepares for the new Halloween season of their family-owned haunted house. When she recognizes signs of a relapse from Paul, she tries to cover them up but struggles to manage as she tests her own relationship to substances and an attraction to new employee Hannah.

1567810.title: The Big Cheese
1567810.overview: A clever American team competes for first place at France's Mondial du Fromage cheese competition.

1568514.title: Beast
1568514.overview: After a final harvest forced upon him by the landlord, an old farmer and his loyal carabao embark on a magical road trip to Manila, chasing the ghost of a niece the years stole from him.
1568514.trailerName: Beast (CinePanalo 2026) Official Trailer - John Arcilla, Ruslan Jacob, Candy Pangilinan, Karl Medina

1571138.title: Equal
1571138.overview: ARASI, an emerging Carnatic singer. AZHAGHU, a freelance software engineer. Their six-year-old daughter, BHOOMI.  On a post-pandemic day under curfew, Arasi prepares for her long-awaited concert. Azhaghu faces an important job interview. Bhoomi has an online school event.  Azhaghu calls his parents, THILLAI and MOHANA for support.  The family's everyday life unfolds the poetic irony of a perpetual mindset, utterly convinced of its own hierarchy, then turns around and calls it EQUAL.

1576834.title: Le Teckel
1576834.overview: Guy Farkas, nicknamed "Le Teckel" (The Dachshund), a seasoned medical representative who has seen it all, will have to team up with a new young executive to sell a new medical drug suspected of having caused hundreds of deaths..

1578306.title: 12 Warriors
1578306.overview: A dozen top warriors from around the world are kidnapped and forced to participate in fight-to-the-death survival games. Affairs are overseen by a disgraced and sociopathic former Russian intelligence officer who has built a shadowy organization with a clientele of crime bosses, politicians, billionaires, and members of the global elite.
1578306.trailerName: Turkish Squid Game | 12 WARRIORS (2025) | Deadly MMA Action

1580162.title: IAI
1580162.overview: After her father’s death, Kana returns home to care for her ailing mother. Soon, she begins experiencing vivid dreams and strange premonitions. When a dream about a high school classmate jumping in front of a train comes true, Kana’s anxiety spirals.

1583234.title: Rattakus
1583234.overview: After a rebellion is crushed by the rats in the sewers of Los Santos, the rats return to a mostly peaceful life until Rattakus is forced to make a difficult decision that will change the fate of every rat in Los Santos.

1592450.title: When Anyone Sees
1592450.overview: Christian, a young man overlooked by society, burdened by a dark past and escalating madness, finds himself trapped in a world of violence and despair.

1598210.title: Lifeline
1598210.overview: How far would you go, and what would you risk for the one you love? What drives Ananya, a city girl, to this distant village and where will her journey lead?

1599746.title: A Russian Winter
1599746.overview: After the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, many people in Russia faced a brutal choice: prison, the army – or exile. Margarita, Yuri and their friends are caught in the crosscurrents of history, with no way to return home, but also no place where they feel truly welcome.

1604226.title: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
1604226.overview: A daughter grows up in a house with a father who is always there but never truly present. When a family crisis forces her to bear the burden of adulthood, she must learn to live without the direction that should come from the figure she misses most, her own father.
1604226.trailerName: “Ayah, Ini Arahnya ke Mana, Ya?” - Official Trailer

1606210.title: Bromance Kadhal
1606210.overview: In a swipe-right generation, an unromantic boy dares to love the old-school way and proves that staying real is the boldest move of all.

1616514.title: The Taro Donatella Story
1616514.overview: From Underdog to legend - From silence to legend. The Taro Donatella Story is the true rise of a man who built an empire alone. A journey of ambition, obsession, and belief in the impossible. - "Mark Zuckerberg & Taro Donatella. One code. One invention. Who actually created the real-time algorithm? The truth behind the biggest lie in social media history - Coming Summer 2026."
1616514.trailerName: THE TARO DONATELLA STORY | Official Teaser (2026) | 4K

1620034.title: Marty, Life Is Short
1620034.overview: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.

1620290.title: Kenan & Kel Meet Frankenstein
1620290.overview: Two delivery drivers' routine drop-off takes a terrifying turn when they arrive at a creepy, out-of-place castle and accidentally awaken Frankenstein’s monster — turning an ordinary night into a fight for survival

1621506.title: Tight Lettuce
1621506.overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

1629058.title: Los Lobos Native Sons
1629058.overview: Los Lobos Native Sons is the definitive chronicle of the global Latin rock ’n’ roll legends Los Lobos, offering an unparalleled 50-year musical journey through exclusive access to the band’s personal archives and extraordinary legacy.

1630850.title: Wildman
1630850.overview: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

1631682.title: 96 Pounds of Dynamite
1631682.overview: Diagnosed at birth with a rare condition that was expected to kill him, Chad "Shorty" McDaniel embraces humor, grit, and a competitive spirit to live the life others said he would never have and shatter assumptions about disability.

1633410.title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
1633410.overview: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

1633794.title: Patlabor EZY File 3
1633794.overview: Patlabor EZY: File 3 is the third of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files. Set in the TV continuity, this new production does not take place in the same timeline as the Patlabor film series or live-action drama.

1636674.title: Beyond Sasquatch
1636674.overview: Three female astronauts reunite after a secret Jupiter mission when a mysterious Sasquatch presence resurfaces. As deaths mount, they confront buried memories and discover the creature is tied to emotion, not violence
1636674.trailerName: BEYOND SASQUATCH (Official Trailer) | Bigfoot Creature Horror

1636866.title: Take Care Bhalobasha
1636866.overview: Upcoming Bengali movie slated for 2026 release.

1646978.title: Mama, bitte lern Deutsch
1646978.overview: Tahsim is eight, loves buttered corn, and hates letters—especially those from the immigration office. Because his mother, Xatun, can neither speak nor read German, he becomes her interpreter, navigating waiting rooms, bureaucratic jargon, and the threat of deportation. At home, Xatun is a linguistic genius full of wit and stories, but outside she’s at a loss and resorts to simple words with flawed sentence structure. While Tahsim struggles to fit in at school with made-up religions and perfect German, he finds himself feeling ashamed of his mother more and more often. Until he realizes that she isn’t the problem—but rather the question he’s been asking her his whole life.

1650370.title: The Third Child
1650370.overview: In a century where humanity has lost its way and boundaries no longer exist, a mother transforms her grief into a final act of hope and resistance.

1652994.title: Wings
1652994.overview: A student on a field trip imagines himself as a classic pilot to work up the courage to talk to his crush.

1659522.title: Balik Eskwela
1659522.overview: Based on a viral Tiktok story from Book of Bad Ideas. A student returns to school and finds herself responsible for saving another student from a serial killer, who only she knows.
1659522.trailerName: VIVA ONE ORIGINALS: ASHTINE, BALIK ESKWELA | TRAILER | STUDIO VIVA

1675138.title: What Is To Come
1675138.overview: After unexpectedly losing her husband, Yehudit has no choice but to start over. In the process, she finds that abrupt and painful detours can lead to bright roads.

1677954.title: Irving Berlin's Top Hat
1677954.overview: Inspired by the iconic 1935 movie musical starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, this acclaimed Chichester Festival Theatre revival recorded from the West End in January 2026 is directed and choreographed by three-time Tony winner Kathleen Marshall.

1678850.title: Date 3
1678850.overview: Haunted by a past abusive relationship, Ella tries to psych herself up for her third date with Harry.

1683714.title: American Heena
1683714.overview: As part of his wedding plans, Dudu needs to go back to Israel from America for a ritual Hina ceremony with his fiance's American family.

1684226.title: Bride of the Year
1684226.overview: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

1685250.title: Мы тебя хвалить не будем
1685250.overview: The story of Alena Lozovskaya, founder of the footwear and clothing brand Razumno.

1686594.title: No More Heroes
1686594.overview: Léa is an old punk, Rémi an old hippie, Tonton a former fairground worker, Kiki a pink-haired Ma' Daltone, and Galak, their poodle. They all live together amidst laughter, drugs and rough love, dividing their time between a cramped Parisian council flat and a chalet in the Alps that’s far too big for them. One day, Kiki has a stroke, plunging her into dependency and forcing her daughter to take charge of her, even though she struggles to look after herself. No More Heroes tells the story of a tribe trying to hold its own in the world.

1688514.title: The Dating App Nightmare
1688514.overview: Single mom Kate signs up for a dating app with her daughter Sarah, turning it into a fun bonding moment. But the fun ends fast when Sarah goes missing after a date with someone she met on the app. With little help, Kate launches her own search.

1689666.title: One Night Only
1689666.overview: A hated, desperate, up-and-coming dance music promoter, across a single frenetic night,  must put on a successful gig, navigating: petty thieves stealing the music equipment, his drug-addled, unconscious headliner and a thousand pounds of urgent debt to a ruthless loan shark, risking his life.

1693442.title: Monay
1693442.overview: Mona, a desperate woman fighting to save the bakery she shares with her younger sister, Monina. When a wealthy businessman offers financial help in exchange for a risky arrangement, Mona must risk love, family, and herself.
1693442.trailerName: MONAY Official Trailer | Sahara Bernales | VMX

1694978.title: Chum
1694978.overview: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

1699970.title: The Welcome Table
1699970.overview: Tells the story of climate refugees across six continents, celebrating the voices and experiences of people living at the forefront of the climate crisis, displaced from their homes by climate disasters.

1700290.title: Constantine the Great: Emperor of New Rome
1700290.overview: Constantine the Great, son of General Constantius Chlorus, rose to power during the Tetrarchy, a division of the Roman Empire among four emperors. After succeeding his father in 306 and being acknowledged as the sole Emperor of the West in 310, he enacted significant military, economic, and religious reforms that unified the empire. This documentary explores his life and reign, highlighting his role in ending the persecution of Christians and the transition from polytheistic beliefs. It also touches on his personal intrigues, including the murder of his concubine Fausta, showcasing his complex legacy of power and grandeur.

1700610.title: Leo Lets It Rain
1700610.overview: Leo, a trans man with undiagnosed ADHD, is on his way to win back his ex-girlfriend when his plans are thwarted by a storm, forcing him to slow down and reevaluate.

1701762.title: No Shit, Sherlock!
1701762.overview: A murder has been committed and a detective is on the case... one of them, at least.

1702082.title: Stupid Children
1702082.overview: A man ends up seeking a violent solution to his relationship issues after encountering an aggressive dog.

1702274.title: Hak: Tuntut atau Tunduk
1702274.overview: Hakim, an operations officer at a public market who is desperate to find money to celebrate the birth of his first child. Amidst the challenging economic pressures, the plot explores issues of oppression, the struggle for moral rights, workers' rights, and the survival of the marhaen group from external domination and an oppressive system.

1702722.title: Kontra K: Orchestrated - Live from Channel Aid 2026

1703170.title: Satellites II
1703170.overview: An AI-generated teaser film to promote the Prada Mode event, which the fashion brand will hold at the iconic Chelsea Hotel during the Tribeca Film Festival. Directed by and co-starring Nicolas Winding Refn and Hideo Kojima.

1703234.title: Mon Taxi
1703234.overview: For years, calling her father was the daily ritual for Moroccan filmmaker Meriem Sakrouhi. When he passed, her urge to stay connected remained. One day, she decides to call him.

1703618.title: Blue Lullaby
1703618.overview: A young girl retraces her relationship with her mother while they bake a pie together. Until she starts to remember what she seemed to have forgotten.

1704322.title: Lo Naveena
1704322.overview: A rustic village boy and his wild friends embark on a chaotic, heartwarming quest to win the heart of his beloved Asha.

1708610.title: Only the Serpent Knows
1708610.overview: Two brothers reunite in their childhood home to speak about the incest one of them suffered there as a child. Over the course of a single day, their conversation intertwines the most difficult questions with the boldest theories, delving deep into our religious and mythological history.

1709890.title: Hanahaki
1709890.overview: Hanahaki tells the story of an impossible love between a noblewoman and a commoner who, due to various circumstances, cannot be together. The word Hanahaki comes from Japanese and represents unrequited love, in which the character suffers with flowers growing inside her because the romance cannot be fulfilled.

1711426.title: Dentro de lo azul
1711426.overview: Two women separate. Their memories resurface tirelessly. A portrait of separation seen through the prism of sapphic nostalgia.

1713538.title: Flaccid
1713538.overview: A surreal feminist satire sees history’s greatest patriarchs - Adam, Genghis Khan, Henry VIII, and Napoleon - undone by Lilith and a mischievous Goddess of the void. Through rich tableaux, symbolic food rituals, and playful myth-making, the film exposes the fragility beneath dominance and reimagines softness as a radical force.

1714114.title: Ashamed
1714114.overview: Before his childhood best friend leaves for good, a closeted married man has one last chance to show the truth — or stay trapped in a life that was never really his.

1715586.title: Ling tosite sigure Shisshin Sasori TOUR 2025 Tornado in Budokan
1715586.overview: A Blu-ray video release fully containing Ling tosite sigure's live performance held at Nippon Budokan on December 27, 2025, finally arrives. This long-awaited release for fans captures the approximately two-hour stage performance in full with outstanding video quality. The package has a special slipcase box design and contains a digipak and a deluxe photo booklet. It is also finished as a collector's item that preserves the heat and tension of the stage as they are. Do not miss Ling tosite sigure's one-of-a-kind sound and the full picture of their overwhelming Budokan performance. A Ling tosite sigure trading card 003 is planned to be included.
